page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, which consists of 70,866 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The absence of hyperthreading ensures that each of the 24 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, offering predictable compute performance.

Due to the reliance on traditional HDD storage rather than solid-state drives, this server is optimized for high-capacity sequential data access rather than high-IOPS random read and write workloads. It represents a cost-efficient solution for massive data storage, log processing, large-scale data warehousing, and distributed file systems where storage density per unit of compute is a primary requirement.
